verdict.line: You lose if Jayce poke-abuses levels 1-5 before you hit 6; you win once Demacian Justice and Stridebreaker let you force a fight he can't kite.

brief.thesis: Jayce is strongest in Cannon Stance before Garen hits level 6 — Shock Blast and Acceleration Gate (E) poke from range while Garen has no way to close the gap except walking. The matchup is measured even at 49.9% over 2058 games despite Jayce holding the lane and solo-kill edge, because once Garen gets Decisive Strike's silence online and Demacian Justice at 6, a single dash-in trade with Perseverance ticking swings it back.

theirWindow.when: Jayce in Cannon Stance, Shock Blast/E up
theirWindow.what: He can poke you down from 600 range with Shock Blast and zone with the Acceleration Gate without ever entering your E (Judgment) radius. Do not walk up to farm into this — eat the poke on cooldown or go wide to split the wave.

yourWindow.when: Jayce's Q (To the Skies!/Shock Blast) just went on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Cooldown is 16/14/12/10/8s, so the gap shrinks fast as he levels it. The moment it's down, close immediately — Q (Decisive Strike) to break any slow and silence him, then W (Courage) and E (Judgment) chain for the trade before he can reset distance.

start.why: Picked in 77.5% of games (50.6% win rate over 1894 games) because the regen and physical damage reduction directly offset Jayce's Shock Blast and auto-poke during the levels 1-5 window where you have no reliable way to close distance.

boots.why: 59.9% pick, 50.5% win rate over 1422 games — the attack speed helps you actually land damage once you force a trade, since the fight window against Jayce is short and burst-dependent, not sustained.

core.why: The dash is the single item that solves Jayce's kiting — it closes the exact gap his Shock Blast and E knockback are designed to create.
Attack speed and move speed let you stick to him after the Stridebreaker dash instead of getting kited back out by his Cannon Stance.
Part of the top build path (55.1% win rate, 316 games) — the grievous wounds shuts down any healing he picks up and the armor pen matters once he builds tanky.

situational.when: he's kiting you across the lane and you need the move speed stacks to close instead of pure burst
you're ahead and want a second dash-adjacent tool to chain cooldowns for repeated all-ins

runes.keystoneWhy: The stacking adaptive force and healing on fully-stacked hits reward the extended trades you're forced into once you finally close distance on a ranged opponent — Jayce's poke means you rarely get a clean burst window, so sustained damage scales better here.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 86.8% of games at 50.3% win rate — Flash is the tool OP.GG explicitly flags for instantly closing the gap when his abilities are down, and Ignite punishes the all-in once you land it since Jayce has no reliable sustain to out-heal it.

playing.title: Track his stance every time he casts
playing.detail: Hammer Stance means leap-and-slow range threat; Cannon Stance means ranged poke and the Acceleration Gate. Your positioning should change completely depending on which one he's in.

playing.title: Never walk up when Shock Blast is up
playing.detail: At levels 1-5 the cooldown is 16-12 seconds and it's his main source of lane advantage — if you see it land, that's your cue the gap is now safe to close for several seconds.

playing.title: Use Perseverance actively between trades
playing.detail: Garen's passive regenerates a percentage of total health per second if you haven't been hit recently — back off and let it tick rather than soaking poke, exactly as OP.GG's tip states.

playing.title: Save Decisive Strike's silence for the engage
playing.detail: Q breaks slows and silences on the next attack — use it the instant you close distance so he can't Thundering Blow or Shock Blast you away mid-trade.

playing.title: Hold Demacian Justice until the kill is certain
playing.detail: At level 6 the cooldown is a brutal 140 seconds, so only commit R when you're sure you get the full trade in — a whiffed execute attempt just hands him the next two minutes of lane.

playing.title: Split the wave if he's zoning with the Gate
playing.detail: When he drops Acceleration Gate to zone you off minions, don't force a bad all-in — let a few minions go and look to punish his next cooldown cycle instead.

playing.title: Play for level 9-13 power spike
playing.detail: Once Stridebreaker is online, your dash directly answers his kiting — this is your best window to start initiating fights instead of only reacting to his.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the ability timings, cooldowns, and tactical reasoning are drawn from the game's own ability text and my own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being punished by Jayce by managing your distance well while activating [P] to increase your sustain. Use Flash to instantly close in or fight him whenever his skills are on cooldown.
